text: With the focus of the Clan, thyme bundles, tansy, plantain bundles, horsetail clumps, elder leaf bundles, dandelions, mullein, blackberry clusters, marigold, burdock roots, ragwort, goldenrod, doses of poppy seeds, wild garlic, rosemary clumps, lungwort, moss clumps, juniper bunches, raspberry clusters, cobwebs, oak leaf bundles, daisies, betony, catmint piles, and mallow were gathered.
During the Gathering, CougarClan's leader announces new warriors. Yewstar leads RiverClan in cheering their names. (CougarClan relations improved.)
Yewstar thinks very often about Nutpaw. (high positive effect)
Yewstar brushes against Carptail while correcting his stance and looks away with a purr. (medium positive effect)
Prancelaurel overheard a joke from Peatcrest she didn't get. (low negative effect)
Elmtrail thinks Prancelaurel is lying when she apologizes for something. (high negative effect)
Prancelaurel accidentally crossed the border on patrol and got her ear torn by an enemy warrior.
Skulkwillow mentions that Primfreckle looks good today. (low positive effect)
Primfreckle is impressed by Yewstar helping others today. (low positive effect)

Peatcrest started a huge argument between Deltakit and Yewstar. (negative effect)
Peatcrest and Primfreckle can always rely on each other. (high positive effect)

While at the Gathering, Peatcrest speaks to the other medicine cats and expresses worry over his herb stores. The medicine cats offer to bring some extra herbs to RiverClan later, to help bolster his supply.

After something unsettling happens, Nymphshine and Poolleaf find comfort in one another's company. (high positive effect)

Driftstripe gives Algaepool a big piece of fresh-kill. (low positive effect)

A medicine cat from HickoryClan comes to RiverClan, asking for lungwort to heal a case of yellowcough. RiverClan has some extra and so decides to share with their allies.

m_c will always love r_c, but has decided to move on.
